title: Argentinian Crustaceans Paella
description: A malty and fluffy Argentinian dish featuring crustaceans, this paella is a show-off recipe that is vegan friendly, it is made with a variety of ingredients and cooked to perfection using sous-vide.
instructions: Heat the malt vinegar in a pan over medium heat until it is reduced by half.
Add the soaked saffron threads, smoked paprika, and turmeric to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the sliced vegan chorizo to the pan and cook until it is browned.
Add the artichoke hearts and crustacean substitute to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the paella rice to the pan and stir to combine with the other ingredients.
Transfer the mixture to a sous-vide bag and seal.
Cook the paella in a water bath at 190 degrees for 45 minutes.
Remove the paella from the bag and serve hot.
